title: The State of School Websites 2026
note: Aggregates computed from automated scans. No individual site is identified.
attribution: Free to use and cite under CC BY 4.0. Credit Clikiti with a link.
citation: Clikiti. (2026, October 12). The state of school websites 2026 (Q4 2026) [Report]. https://clikiti.com/research/education/2026-q4
audience: Web agencies and freelancers selling to private schools and tutoring centres
findings: Only 68% of the 114 private school and tutoring websites we scanned show what the school costs without the parent having to ask.
A typical site answers three of the six questions parents ask before choosing (mean 2.9).
The median overall score is 74 out of 100 (mean 75).
The least-answered questions are "Can I reach a person?" (9%), "Is it recognised?" (27%) and "When are the holidays?" (46%).
The best-answered are "Can we afford it?" (76%) and "What does it cost?" (68%).
Tutoring and learning centres have the highest median score (78), against 75 for small private schools and 73 for independent schools.
57% fail "Loads in under 2.5 s on a phone" (Core Web Vitals · LCP).

agencyProblems.label: Phone and email tappable, hours stated
agencyProblems.question: Can I reach a person?
agencyProblems.fix: Tappable phone and email in the header, with office hours.
agencyProblems.pitch: On a phone, reaching a person takes more than one tap.

agencyProblems.label: Text contrast passes 4.5:1
agencyProblems.fix: Raise text contrast to at least 4.5:1 in the theme.
agencyProblems.pitch: Parts of the site are hard to read, and it is a WCAG failure.

agencyProblems.label: Accreditation shown
agencyProblems.question: Is it recognised?
agencyProblems.fix: Show accreditation clearly, with the accrediting body named and linked.
agencyProblems.pitch: Your best proof of quality is invisible on the site.

agencyProblems.label: Loads in under 2.5 s on a phone
agencyProblems.fix: Resize and compress the hero image, defer scripts, aim for under 2.5 s on a phone.
agencyProblems.pitch: Your home page takes several seconds to appear on a parent's phone.

agencyProblems.label: Term dates published as a page
agencyProblems.question: When are the holidays?
agencyProblems.fix: Term dates as a web page, not a scanned PDF.
agencyProblems.pitch: Current families hunt for term dates every holiday.
